book.name: LUUKA
book.title: oMwazi Mwinja gwa Yeesu Krisitu nk'oku LUUKA aguyandikaga

content: Muchilange obulyaalya
Amo mango, abantu banene bachigusha bihumbi n'ebihumbi, oku bulyo baalema baalabarhana. Yeesu arhanga kubwira abigirizwa baage ntya: «Muchilange n'echachu
y'aBafarisaayo, k'okuderha obulyaalya.
«Ntaacho gishukuliirwe girhagashukuulwa, na ntaacho chibishirwe girhakamenyekana.
Cho girhumire ngasi byooshi mwaderhere omu mwizimya nji byayunviikana ezuuba lyakola. Echi mwabohereeze omu gurhwi ebusiika, nji chayaamagazizwa oku nju elugulu.
«Mwe beera baani, mbabwirire byo: murhayuubahaga abantu bayirha omubiri, na nta chindi bakanachigala kujira enyuma z'aho.
Nkola nabayeereka nde mukwaneene kuyuubaha. Muyuubahe Nnamahanga, yegwerhe obuhashe b'okuyirha n'ogukabula omu hantu h'amalibuko manene. Neechi, mbabwirire byo, oyoola yi muhemerwe kuyuubaha.
Ka barhaguza nyunyi erhaano z'ebishwa oku bicheri bibiri? Aliko, chiro nta nguma omu zo eyibiriirwe na Nnamahanga.
N'enviiri z'amarhwe menyu zooshi ziganjirwe. Leero, murhayuubahaga chiro; mugwerhe akamaro kanene kulusha ebishwa binene.»
Okuyemeera changwa okulahira Yeesu
«Mbabwirire byo: ngasi yeeshi nji wanyemeera embere z'abantu, Mwene oMuntu naye nj'amuyemeera embere za bamalahika ba Nnamahanga.
Aliko, ola nji wandahira embere z'abantu, naye nj'alahirwa embere za bamalahika ba Nnamahanga.
«Na ngasi yeeshi nji waderhera kubi Mwene oMuntu nj'ababalirwa, aliko ola nji wadukanga Muuka-Mutagatiifu arhakababalirwa.
«Hano nji babakululira omu masinagoogi, abarhwali n'abarhegesi, murhayuubahiraga obulyo nji mwabuurana, changwa bichi nji mwaderha.
Bulaala Muuka-Mutagatiifu nj'abayigiriza ho n'aho bichi mukwaneene kuderha.»
Omugani g'omuchire muhwinja
Muntu muguma mw'abo bantu banene abwira Yeesu ntya: «Mwigiriza, bwira mwene weerhu ampe echaani chigabi ch'omwandu gwerhu.»
Yeesu amushubiza ntya: «Muza wee, nde wanjiraga muzuuzi changwa muntu w'okubagabira omwandu gwenyu?»
Ashuba kubabwira ntya: «Muchilange n'okugwarha amahugu ma ngasi buuko, kwenge akalamo k'omuntu garharhengeere omu kanji k'ebikulo byaage.»
Yeesu ababwira ogu mugani: «Eshwa ly'omugale muguma lyayeeza bweneene.
Alema akengeera n'oguchiibaza ntya: ‹Bichi njirage? Bulaala ntagwerhe hantu hanene h'ogushaluulira emyaaka yaani.›
Aderha ntya: ‹Tala oku naajira: nashanda enguli zaani, nayumbaka ezigalihire; nji nalundira mo amahemba maani n'ebindi bikulo.›
N'enyuma z'aho, nji nachibwira ntya omu murhima: ‹Ngwerhe ebintu binene bweneene bibiikirwe, bya myaaka minene; nahumuuka, naalya, nanywa, naashagaluka.›
Aliko Nnamahanga amubwira ntya: ‹Oli muhwinja! M'obu budufu waafa! Ka warheganyize nde nji waaba nyina ebi bintu byooshi wachibikiire?›»
Yeesu ashuba kuderha ntya: «Ntyo ku bibeera omuntu ochihakira ebikulo byaage yenyine, aliko eyi arhali mugale embere za Nnamahanga.»
Oguchilangalira Nnamahanga
Yeesu ashubi bwira abigirizwa baage ntya: «Mulolage egirhumire mbabwira oku murhachiganyaga elugulu w'akalamo kenyu, akaba bichi mwalya; changwa elugulu w'omubiri gwenyu, akaba bichi mwayambala.
Bulaala akalamo kali ka bulagiirire kulusha ebiryo, n'omubiri guli gwabulagiirire kulusha emyambalo.
Mulole ebihungwe: birhahinga birhanashaluula, birhajira aha bibiikira changwa enguli. Aliko Nnamahanga yebiliisa! Mwabo muli b'akamaro kanene kulusha enyunyi!
Nde omu mwabo omu guchiiganya, wakagala kuleehya chiro bugeeke akalamo kaage?
Akaba ntaacho mwagachigalira mw'ebi bintu bigeeke, gichi chagarhuma mwachilunza oku bisigeere?
Mulole guurhe ebirhi biyaasa: birhakola, birhaluka fulema; aliko, mbabwire oku chiro mwami Solomoono omu bukuuze bwage arhayambalaga nka chiguma omu byo.
Akaba Nnamahanga ayambisa ntya egirhi chiri omu shwa zeene n'omuseezi banagiheba omu chibeeye, bichi byaagarhuma arhabayambisa nenyu kulusha, mwe bantu b'obwemeezi bugeeke!
Nenyu, murhagendaga mwashonda gichi mwalya changwa gichi mwanywa, murhanachibuliisaga omurhuula.
Ebyo byooshi by'abapagaani ba lino gulu bashonda buzira kuluha. Yisho wenyu ayinji oku mubikeneere.
Ahuubwe, murhange mushonde obwime bwa Nnamahanga, n'ebyoola bindi naye nj'abaheereza byo.
Murhayuubahaga, mwe buso bugeeke; kwenge byasimiisize Yisho okubaha oBwami bwage.»
Ebikulo omu mpingu

Yeesu ashuba kuderha ntya: «Muguze ebintu byenyu, muhe abakene efuranga. Muchijirire orhushaho rhw'efuranga rhurhagashaaja, muchibiikire ebikulo birhaagahwa omu mpingu. Eyoola nta mwizi wakayegeera yo na nta mushwa gwakabibiihya.
Bulaala emunda ebikulo byaawe biri, yi n'omurhima gwawe gwaba guli.»
Omugani g'okuneeka
Yeesu ashuba kuderha ntya: «Muchirheganye, mube muyambeere emyambalo y'akaasi n'amatara machaanirwe.
Nenyu mube kuguma n'aba bantu bali balinga nnahamwabo agaluke gurhenga oku buhya, hano akongoorha oku lunvi bagale kumuchinguulira jubaajuba.
Bagishirwe aba bagaragu nnahamwabo ashimaana bataramire ey'agaluka! Okuli, mbabwirire, naye nj'ayambala emyambalo y'akaasi, nj'abayikaza n'okuyinja kubaha ebiryo.
Nk'ayinjire omu budufu ahagarhi changwa buyerekeera gucha, akanababugaana bagitaramire, bagishirwe!»
«Mumenye bwinja: nyina enju nk'amenyaga aha saa zinga egishambo chigwasize kuyinja, arhakalekere enju yaage eshandwe.
Nenyu leero muchirheganye, bulaala Mwene oMuntu nj'ayinja omu saa murhaganiizize.»
Petero abaza Yeesu ntya: «Nnaweerhu, ka rhwewe rh'obwirire ogu mugani changwa abantu booshi?»
Nnaweerhu ashubiza ntya: «Nde ye mukozi orhahemuka, na munya bwenge, eyi nnahamwabo akajira mwimangizi w'abandi bakozi baage, y'abaheereza ebiryo omu gashanji gahemerwe?
Agishirwe oyu muja, akaba nnahamwabo hano agaluka, amushimaana ali akola ntyo!
Okuli mbabwirire: nnahamwabo nj'amujira mwimangizi w'ebikulo byaage byooshi.
Aliko, nk'oyo muja achibwirire ntya omu murhima gwage: ‹Nnahamwerhu alegamire kuyinja›, agarhondera gukubirha abaabo baja b'abalume n'aba bakazi, agarhondera kulya, kunywa n'okulaluka,
nnahamwabo nj'agaluka olusiku oyo muja arhalikengereere, n'esa arhamenyere. Nj'amuhana bweneene n'okumuyikaza haguma n'abahemusi.
«Omuja nji waaba amenyere ogushonda kwa nnahamwabo, aliko arharheganyaga n'okujira echintu chiyerekeere oko gushonda, nj'ashuurhwa enkoni zirhankaganjwa.

Sy'aliko, ola orhamenyaga ogushonda kwa nnahamwabo, n'okuba ajirire ebintu bikwaneene obuhane nj'ashuurhwa nkoni zigeeke. Eyi baheere bintu binene, nji baamubaza binene; eyi babikiisize binene, nji bamuhema binene kulusha.»
Yeesu, empanvu y'entambala
«Nayinjaga guhira omuliro oku gulu; nagashondere gube gwachaanirwe!
Nkwaneene kubatiizwa omu malibuko; n'omurhima gwani gurhaviire gwarhuleera kugera birhaza kujirika.»
«Ka muganiizize oku nayinjaga kuleerha omurhuula oku gulu? Nangwa, mbabwire okuli, sy'aliko obuhaka.
Gurhenga bunoola, bantu barhaano balamire omu nju nguma barhakayunviikana, basharhu nji balwisa babiri, na babiri nji balwisa basharhu.
Omwana n'eshe barhakayunviikana, omunyere na nyina barhakayunviikana, omwazaana na nazaala barhakayunviikana.»
Okumenya ebihe
Yeesu ashuba kubwira olubaga lw'abantu ntya: «Eyi mwabona ebichu byahulukira ebuzikiro bw'ezuuba, ho n'aho mwanaderha: ‹Envula yayinjire›, ebyoola byanahika.
Na nk'omuyaga gw'egarhongo guli kugera, mwanaderha: ‹Echuuka chaaba.› Ebyoola byanahika.
Mwe ndyaalya! Muyinji kumenya oboorhere bw'egulu n'echaalege. Gurhe mwagafundwa kumenya amango mali bunoola?»
Okuyunvikana n'mushombanyi
«Na girhuma mwenyine murhagala kumenya ebikwaneene?

Nka waaja kubuurana n'ogusidaakire embere z'omurhegesi, ochihangaane oyunviikane naye omu njira; y'arhaguheeka embere z'omuzuuzi. Omuzuuzi naye akaguhaana omu maboko m'omupoolisi, n'oyo mupoolisi anaguhira omu munyororo.
Okuli nkubwirire, orhagarhenga omu munyororo orhanahongere olufuranga lw'obuzinda omu zibaguchiire.»
